sources.title: Fine-tuning SmolVLA for Cube Pick-and-Place on SO-101
sources.snippet: The task: pick up a small cube from a randomized position and place it in a bowl. 10-second episodes, 30fps, recorded via teleoperation with the leader arm. SmolVLA vs ACT # SmolVLA is a 500M+ parameter model, but you only fine-tune ~50M (the action expert + projections). The vision encoder (SigLIP) and language model (SmolLM2) stay frozen.
